questions.question: You’re running late for an important meeting and your colleague asks, *'Did you manage to finish the report by the deadline?'*. What would be the most appropriate response if you had only just sent it?
options: Yes, I sent it just before you called. I’ll be there in 10 minutes.
Oh, I’m sorry—I didn’t realise how late it was! I’ll make sure it’s ready by the next day.
The deadline was too tight; I couldn’t finish it on time. I’ll work on it tomorrow.
Actually, I didn’t have time to finish it. I’ll bring it later.
questions.answer: Yes, I sent it just before you called. I’ll be there in 10 minutes.

questions.question: Your friend suggests, *'Let’s go to the cinema tonight—what about you?'*. How would you respond if you prefer to stay at home and watch a film on your own?
options: That sounds great! I’ll definitely join you.
I’m afraid I’ve got plans tonight, but I’ll think about it.
Actually, I’d rather stay at home and watch something by myself.
No, I don’t like the cinema. I prefer books instead.
questions.answer: Actually, I’d rather stay at home and watch something by myself.

questions.question: During a job interview, the interviewer asks, *'What do you think are the biggest challenges of your future role?'*. How would you respond if you believe the company’s culture is too rigid?
options: I think flexibility and teamwork would be really important to me.
The challenges would be learning new systems and adapting quickly.
I’m not sure—I’d rather focus on the tasks first.
I agree, but I’m confident I can handle it with experience.
questions.answer: I think flexibility and teamwork would be really important to me.

questions.question: A classmate asks, *'Do you think climate change is a serious issue?'*. How would you respond if you believe it is but want to encourage further discussion?
options: Yes, it’s definitely a serious issue. We should all do something about it.
I don’t think it’s that important. Let’s talk about something else.
I agree, but I’m not sure how to fix it. Maybe we need experts?
No, it’s not a problem at all—it’s just nature doing what it does.
questions.answer: Yes, it’s definitely a serious issue. We should all do something about it.

questions.question: Your boss asks, *'Could you help me with this presentation for tomorrow?'*. How would you respond if you have a prior commitment but can assist with a smaller task?
options: Of course! I’ll take care of the data part. What time works for you?
I’m sorry, I can’t take on the whole presentation—I’ll just help with the slides.
I’d love to, but I’m busy with something else. Maybe next week?
That’s too much work for me. I’ll leave it to someone else.
questions.answer: Of course! I’ll take care of the data part. What time works for you?
